question: Should `openclaw.ai` consume `openclaw/design-system` through a public or otherwise deployable release source, or should maintainers approve private cross-repository credentials for hosted builds and skills installation?
rationale: The remaining blocker is an organization distribution and credential-boundary choice for a private design-system repository, not a mechanical code edit automation can safely choose.

options.title: Use a deployable public source
options.body: Publish or expose the package and skills through a source that clean clones, GitHub Actions, Vercel, and contributors can fetch without private SSH credentials.

options.title: Approve private build credentials
options.body: Keep the private SSH source only if maintainers explicitly own the deploy key or machine-user credential scope, rotation, and failure mode.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Leave this PR draft until the design-system distribution policy is settled outside this consumer repository.

recommendation.title: Use a deployable public source
recommendation.body: Publish or expose the package and skills through a source that clean clones, GitHub Actions, Vercel, and contributors can fetch without private SSH credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: The package, dependency, and product-boundary history points most directly to this handle for the distribution and credential choice.
